scope.target: Provider-neutral CLI execution-routing contract and machine-readable schema
constraints: Tracked files contain no personal route values
Readiness and execution evidence remain distinct
Provider adapters do not own portable semantics

steps: Inventory existing contracts and schema conventions
Define route, fallback, retry, evidence, and consent semantics
Add deterministic schema validation and indexes
execution.last_completed_step: Defined and validated the portable contract, schema, authority order, route vocabulary, and fail-closed rules
execution.next_action: Present the implemented schema shape for owner review

results.summary: Added a provider-neutral CLI execution-routing contract and machine-readable schema without populated host defaults or non-CLI routing fields.
results.residual_risk: Future incompatible schema revisions will require an explicit versioned migration decision.
